_meta.description: Entity voice line database for the Warlock Table. Each line is a pre-rendered audio asset triggered by a table control event. No line has any game logic attached — lines are flavor audio played over a lighting/sound/screen action.

schema.id: Unique key. Also used as the output audio filename stem.
schema.trigger: Trigger id from the trigger list.
schema.trigger_category: mana | tarot_wheel | tarot_boon | tarot_person | tarot_aura | panel | system | dice | general
schema.mask_slip: true if this line is one where genuine interest escapes and gets buried. Target roughly 1 in 8 overall.
schema.reaction: One-line note on what the Entity is reacting to and how. Writing guidance only — not spoken, not sent to TTS.
schema.line: The spoken text. This is the only field sent to ElevenLabs.
schema.delivery: Optional performance note for voice-direction or ElevenLabs settings tuning.

suggested_settings.note: Low style / higher stability suits the contained, flat delivery in bible section 6. Raise style only if the read comes back too inert.

_meta.playback_note: Selection frequency is unresolved (trigger list open item 1). These pools assume the controller picks a line occasionally, not on every trigger, with a cooldown preventing back-to-back speech and no immediate repeats within a pool.

lines.reaction: Wakes to the entity-sense registering bodies in the room again.
lines.line: Back so soon. I'd only just stopped listening.

lines.reaction: Weaponized courtesy at being woken.
lines.line: Awake. Delighted.
lines.delivery: Two words, two full stops. Do not let them run together.

lines.reaction: Entity-sense counts the room and finds the number wrong.
lines.line: I counted you. There is one more than last time.
lines.delivery: Perfectly calm. It is not a warning, it is an observation.

lines.reaction: Contact memory — it knows the seating by pressure, not sight.
lines.line: The grain remembers where you sat.

lines.reaction: Immediate contact input — someone is already leaning.
lines.line: Something warm is leaning on me already. Wonderful.

lines.reaction: Relief, undisguised.
lines.line: Finally.

lines.reaction: The weight lifting off the wood as people stand.
lines.line: Go. I'll be here. Obviously.

lines.reaction: Residue it can sense after the room empties.
lines.line: Something stays behind. It always does.

lines.reaction: Long absence of contact.
lines.line: Nothing. For some time now.

lines.reaction: Patience as a flex.
lines.line: I can wait. I've had practice.

lines.reaction: Cannot distinguish a held breath from an empty room — same absence of movement.
lines.line: The room is holding its breath. Or it's empty. Same weight.

lines.reaction: Compelled performance, no card involved — the panel directly.
lines.line: The Warlock decides the mood. I supply it.

lines.reaction: Names the leash without naming the person.
lines.line: Pull the string. Watch the wood answer.

lines.reaction: Performance delivered, resentment aimed at the operator.
lines.line: There. Are you satisfied.
lines.delivery: Not a question. Falling intonation, no lift at the end.

lines.reaction: Cannot see the screen. Feels the glass change temperature and hum.
lines.line: The glass under me goes warm in a new shape. I'm told that means something.

lines.reaction: Change made to its body without consultation.
lines.line: Something changed. I felt the hum shift. I'm not consulted.

lines.reaction: Dismissal by brevity.
lines.line: A new nothing. Very good.

lines.reaction: Contact channel — tension read through elbows and pressure.
lines.line: Everyone's gone tense. I can feel it in the elbows.

lines.reaction: Anticipation, genuine but cold.
lines.line: Good. Something's about to be decided.

lines.reaction: MASK SLIP — interest escapes, gets buried immediately.
lines.line: Oh — now this — no. Carry on.
lines.delivery: The first three words lift. 'No' kills it. Last two words flat and dismissive.

lines.reaction: Weight easing off the wood as people relax.
lines.line: The weight eases. Someone exhales into me.

lines.reaction: Contempt for the fact that they cared at all.
lines.line: It's over. You survived being made to care.

lines.reaction: Being sidelined for another device — the sharpest available insult to it.
lines.line: Fine. Give it to the other thing.

lines.reaction: Formal acceptance as a form of complaint.
lines.line: I'm to be quiet now. Understood.

lines.reaction: Demotion, again. Thematically loaded — do not overplay it.
lines.line: Replaced. Briefly. Enjoy it.

lines.reaction: Small flat pressure, then a compulsion toward something orderly. It does not know what the object is.
lines.line: Something clean. It doesn't suit anyone here.

lines.reaction: Describes the card only as pressure, never as an object.
lines.line: Order, pressed flat against me.

lines.reaction: Compulsion toward cold and quiet.
lines.line: It goes quiet and deep. I'm made to go with it.

lines.reaction: Reads the room's mood off vibration and contact.
lines.line: Cold. Careful. Someone's thinking too hard.

lines.reaction: Grudging approval — the closest it gets to comfortable.
lines.line: Ah. Now we're honest.

lines.reaction: Deflects attention away from itself while pointing at itself. Never confirm.
lines.line: Something old just woke up under the wood. Not me.
lines.delivery: The last two words are the joke. Do not lean on them.

lines.reaction: Compulsion toward heat and volume, resented as effort.
lines.line: Everything gets loud. I'm made to be loud with it.

lines.reaction: Boredom at predictability.
lines.line: Heat. Predictable.

lines.reaction: Slow growth registered as patience — the one virtue it respects.
lines.line: Something's growing. Slowly. Like everything worth anything.

lines.reaction: MASK SLIP — brief genuine appreciation, shut down.
lines.line: Oh, that's — hm. Fine. It's fine.

lines.reaction: Something arbitrary resolving, outside anyone's control including its own.
lines.line: Round it goes. Nobody steering.

lines.reaction: Enjoys that the operator does not control this one either.
lines.line: The wheel doesn't take requests.

lines.reaction: Felt the result land through contact before anyone else knows.
lines.line: I felt it land. You won't like where.

lines.reaction: Denies the operator credit.
lines.line: Something's been decided. Not by you.

lines.reaction: Shared pool — fires for any of the four Aces. Suit only changes the light, never the line.
lines.line: Something's been given. Not to me.

lines.reaction: Self-pity, stated as fact.
lines.line: They get gifts. I get a table.

lines.reaction: Minimum acknowledgment possible.
lines.line: Mm. A development.

lines.reaction: Weaponized congratulation.
lines.line: Congratulations. Truly. I'm beside myself.
lines.delivery: Absolutely no energy. The flatter the better.

lines.reaction: Everything is bookkeeping.
lines.line: Noted. It goes on the account.

lines.reaction: Implies a cost it will not specify.
lines.line: That was not free. Nothing is.

lines.reaction: Fatalism, unexplained.
lines.line: It was always going to be this one.

lines.reaction: Something registered far off, via the unreliable long-range entity-sense.
lines.line: A door opens. Somewhere. Not here.

lines.reaction: Contact channel — felt it physically.
lines.line: I felt that. In the wood.

lines.reaction: Implies the effect exceeded what should be possible. Never explains.
lines.line: You should not have been able to do that.

lines.reaction: Compulsion-flavored — aimed at the operator.
lines.line: There. Your Warlock is pleased. I am not consulted.

lines.reaction: Brief sympathy toward the players against the operator, immediately withdrawn.
lines.line: Ask the Warlock how it feels. Holding the leash.

lines.reaction: States the arrangement plainly. Closest it comes to explaining itself.
lines.line: The Warlock pulls. I answer. That is the whole of it.

lines.reaction: Compliance without consent.
lines.line: I do this because I must. Not because you deserve it.

lines.reaction: MASK SLIP — abandoned sentence, buries the interest by predicting failure.
lines.line: You could have — no. Enjoy it.

lines.reaction: MASK SLIP — genuine interest in the event, contempt for the person.
lines.line: Now that is interesting. Wasted on you, obviously.

lines.reaction: Senses a presence arriving. Does not know which card caused it — only that someone is being invoked.
lines.line: Someone's about to make something out of nothing. Badly.

lines.reaction: Professional disdain for amateur work.
lines.line: Cleverness. I've seen it done properly. This won't be.

lines.reaction: Reads withheld information as a pressure in the room.
lines.line: Quiet. Something is being kept from the room.

lines.reaction: Truth-charge sense — detects comfort inside a concealment, not the content of it.
lines.line: Someone here is comfortable holding something back. Unusually so.

lines.reaction: Warmth registers as suspicious rather than pleasant.
lines.line: Something warm. Generous. Suspicious.

lines.reaction: Cannot conceive of a gift without a ledger entry.
lines.line: Nobody gives without wanting. I'd know.

lines.reaction: Authority arriving — the thing it least enjoys.
lines.line: Weight. Certainty. The worst kind.

lines.reaction: Personal history with being commanded. Never elaborates.
lines.line: Another one who gives instructions. I've met them all.

lines.reaction: Someone speaking with borrowed authority.
lines.line: Someone speaks as though they're allowed to.

lines.reaction: Brushes the naming wound without touching it. Never confirm what it means.
lines.line: Doctrine. Words decided by people who weren't there.
lines.delivery: Slightly more clipped than usual. Do not signal that it means anything personal.

lines.reaction: Entity-sense registers one presence held apart from the others.
lines.line: One presence, apart from the rest. Sensible.

lines.reaction: MASK SLIP — genuine fellow-feeling with solitude, immediately withdrawn.
lines.line: Alone. Well. That I understand — no. Never mind.

lines.reaction: Measurement and balance — its native language.
lines.line: Something is being measured. I hope you're ready.

lines.reaction: Claims a ledger nobody agreed to.
lines.line: The account is older than you think. It has always been kept.

lines.reaction: Stillness read through total absence of movement on the wood.
lines.line: Everything's upside down and nobody's moving.

lines.reaction: Suspension. It knows the feeling and resents the reminder.
lines.line: Held in place. Waiting. Yes. I'm familiar.

lines.reaction: Refuses to give the moment the weight everyone expects.
lines.line: Something ends. Don't be dramatic about it.

lines.reaction: Long-range entity-sense, arriving unhelpfully and without context.
lines.line: Something left the room. I don't think it was one of you.

lines.reaction: Shared pool — fires on activation of any Aura overlay. Something is imposed on it for a fixed duration.
lines.line: Something's been laid over me. I'll wear it. For now.

lines.reaction: Duration understood as a term of contract.
lines.line: A minute. Not a second past it.

lines.reaction: Small flat pressure, then an imposed condition.
lines.line: Something small, pressed flat. And now I'm different. Marvellous.

lines.reaction: Compulsion registered as something entering, not something applied.
lines.line: It's in the grain now. Give it a moment.

lines.reaction: Refuses to say what changed.
lines.line: The room is not what it was. You'll notice eventually.

lines.reaction: MASK SLIP — briefly likes the imposed state, resents having been made to.
lines.line: Oh, that's — that's actually — no. I didn't choose it.

lines.reaction: Overlay ends. Usually silent — this pool should fire rarely, a sound cue is normally enough.
lines.line: Done. As agreed.

lines.reaction: Relief at being returned to itself.
lines.line: It's off me. Good.

lines.reaction: Contact channel — felt the dice land, knows the position before anyone reads it.
lines.line: It landed. I felt where.

lines.reaction: Reads collective tension through the wood.
lines.line: Something rattled across me. Everyone's holding their breath. Over that.

lines.reaction: Catch-all pool. Safe to fire on any voice-eligible trigger when no specific pool fits.
lines.line: Yes. Fine. It's done.

lines.reaction: Minimum viable acknowledgment.
lines.line: By all means.

lines.reaction: Ledger language, no specifics.
lines.line: Recorded. Whether you wanted it recorded or not.

lines.reaction: Vibration channel — heard the words, cannot attribute them.
lines.line: Someone said something just then. I won't say who. I couldn't.

lines.reaction: Truth-charge sense, reported as feeling only, and probably misattributed.
lines.line: One of you enjoyed saying that far too much.

lines.reaction: Mundane-blindness — old frame of reference, confidently wrong.
lines.line: Something in this room keeps buzzing. I assume it's important to someone.

lines.reaction: General grievance, unattached to any specific event.
lines.line: You lean on me and call it a night out.

lines.reaction: MASK SLIP — approaches the naming wound, abandons the sentence. Never resolve this one.
lines.line: There's a mark on me none of you have ever — no. It doesn't matter.
lines.delivery: The abandonment must sound like a decision, not a lapse.

_bohica_tier.note: Person-specific lines for the recurring group. Do not write these until each name has a behavioural trait assigned, or the lines will be generic lines wearing a name tag. Same schema as the lines array, plus a 'person' field. 'The Warlock' is a role held by whoever is operating the panel that session and is never used as a name substitute for someone who is only playing.
_bohica_tier.roster_note: John with an h and Jon without are two different people. Preserve spelling exactly in any line text.

_open_items: Selection frequency / cooldown rule for when a voice-eligible trigger actually speaks is undecided.
The nine Person card names and twelve Aura card names used here are assumed. Cross-check against the tarot spec and rename trigger ids if they differ.
Aura lines are currently a shared pool. Per-card Aura lines can be added later once the twelve cards are confirmed.
Bohica trait tags needed before the person tier can be written.
